title: Registration Criteria for Performance Inspection Agency Businesses (related to Article 14 (1))
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters [Attached Table 2] <Amended 2018.12.11>

Registration Criteria for Performance Inspection Agency Businesses (related to Article 14 (1))

| Category | Registration criteria |
|---|---|
| Personnel requirements | All of the following personnel requirements must be met. |
| Personnel, item 1 | Employ at least one construction engineer of intermediate grade or higher in each of the following professional fields: (a) Mechanical engineering; (b) Electricity and electronics. |
| Personnel, item 2 | The engineers under item 1 must, after recognition of their relevant technical qualifications, have completed the practical education and training course conducted by the Minister of the Interior and Safety pursuant to Article 30 of the Act. |
| Equipment held | Hold all of the following equipment: 1. Equipment for performance testing of length, angle, and pressure; 2. Equipment for measuring current, voltage, and resistance; 3. Data-processing programs; 4. Data-measurement equipment. |
